descriptions.django-docker: Django project zday run with Docker Compose: a Dockerfile for the app, nginx as reverse proxy, PostgreSQL data directory and an init script. The README walks through a Python virtualenv and the compose setup.
descriptions.ooniversity_django_courses_04: Django coursework from an ooniversity Python course: a learning-centre site with apps for courses, coaches and students, models, forms, admin, migrations and tests.
descriptions.openai-k8s-manifest: Portfolio of Kubernetes manifests generated with OpenAI from short prompts: pod, liveness and readiness probes, volume mounts, resources, secret env, multi-container pod, Job and CronJob.
descriptions.automation-token-update: Terraform configuration for GCP Workload Identity Federation, GitHub Actions, Secret Manager and Pub/Sub, accompanying tf-gcp-gke-cluster-flux. Includes Python Cloud Function code for triggering GitHub Actions; the README marks this integration as in development and requiring manual configuration.
descriptions.flux-monitoring: Kubernetes monitoring examples delivered by Flux: kube-prometheus-stack, Loki, Fluent-bit and Grafana dashboards for the cluster and Flux control plane. Includes cert-manager and OpenTelemetry manifests, but the README marks the OpenTelemetry integration as not working yet.
descriptions.everstake-demo: Talos Linux and Sidero Omni architecture demo describing three control-plane nodes on AWS EC2, bare-metal workers and a KubeSpan WireGuard mesh. Includes Argo CD ApplicationSets and manifests for Cilium, kube-prometheus-stack, OpenEBS Mayastor and Vault.
descriptions.omni: Example of managing a Talos Linux Kubernetes cluster with Sidero Labs Omni, with Argo CD and ApplicationSets for application management and cluster bootstrap.
descriptions.kubectl-kubeplugin: Bash kubectl plugin that formats CPU and memory usage from kubectl top for pods or nodes, taking namespace and resource type as arguments. Installable with curl or through a custom Krew index.
descriptions.module3_containerization: Course module on containerization, one branch per task: from chroot to a container, cgroups and resource control, building a container image from scratch, running your own Kubernetes cluster, and a Makefile plus Dockerfile coding session.
descriptions.module4-PoC: Concept, proof of concept and MVP for a local Kubernetes development environment for the fictional startup AsciiArtify: comparison of minikube, kind and k3d, and a GitOps demo with Argo CD.
descriptions.kafka: Apache Kafka on Kubernetes examples using kind, Bitnami charts with KRaft or ZooKeeper, and the Strimzi operator. Includes MirrorMaker 2 manifests and a documented consumer-first migration from a ZooKeeper-based cluster to a KRaft cluster.
descriptions.webserver: Minimal web server in a shell script built on netcat, packaged with a Dockerfile and docker-compose.
descriptions.vanelin: GitHub profile of Ivan Voloboyev from Ukraine, who describes himself as a DevOps, SysOps and Platform Engineer with a network engineering background. Interests include cloud platforms, process automation and continuous learning.
descriptions.tf-gcp-gke-cluster-flux: Terraform configuration for a GKE cluster on Google Cloud and Flux bootstrap from a GitHub repository. Includes deploy keys, Google Secret Manager and KMS integration, and Infracost cost estimates.
descriptions.MikrotikPublicRepository: Fork of a collection of MikroTik RouterOS scripts: checking for RouterOS updates, configuration backups sent by e-mail, bandwidth-exceeded notifications, creating PPP users, and e-mail and Telegram alerts.

GitOps.description: Declarative delivery to Kubernetes where the cluster state is reconciled from git or an OCI artifact by Flux or Argo CD.

Kubernetes.description: Running, operating and extending Kubernetes: clusters, controllers, manifests, plugins and workloads.

Infrastructure as Code.description: Cloud infrastructure described as code with Terraform or OpenTofu on Google Cloud and AWS.

CI/CD.description: Build, test and release pipelines with GitHub Actions and Jenkins, including container image and Helm chart releases.

AI agents and MCP.description: AI agents, Model Context Protocol servers, agent memory, embeddings and LLM-assisted tooling.

Networking.description: Routers, NAT, VPN meshes and network automation: MikroTik RouterOS, AWS NAT instances, WireGuard.

Observability.description: Metrics, logs, traces and dashboards: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry, Phoenix.

Go development.description: Applications and Kubernetes controllers written in Go, packaged with container images and Helm charts.

Python and Django.description: Python web applications with Django, and Python used for cloud functions and automation.

Courses and learning.description: Coursework, labs and study repositories from DevOps, Kubernetes, AWS and Python courses.
